cohort: The study included 664 women divided into groups based on spontaneous preterm and term deliveries.
finding: The G allele of IL1R2 rs2072476 polymorphism was significantly associated with a reduced risk of preterm birth in the Indian ethnic subgroup, meaning Indian women with this minor allele were more likely to deliver at term.
gest_age: Preterm delivery (<37 weeks), Term delivery (>37 weeks)
